note: Rules with value null are 'to set': they must be given a value before go-live; none is invented here.

rules.name: Four value levers, exactly one per entry
rules.value: increase-revenue (revenue gained), retain-revenue (contract value at risk), reduce-cost (hours saved × rate), avoid-cost (hours avoided × rate).
rules.why: Replaces the opportunity score (frequency, business impact, urgency, sponsor multiplier) with one £ figure a named owner stands behind.
rules.source: Feature Scoring Model, 25 Sep 2026 (Ajay Singh)

rules.name: The lever decides who signs the figure
rules.value: Revenue levers: Sales (Chris). Cost levers: Operations (Susan, Ilaria); engineering hours on an engineering-raised cost entry: Product & Engineering (Bartosz, Ajay). A funded entry is signed by its funding approver (fs-funded-approver). Exactly one signature per figure.
rules.why: The layer that owns the lever answers for the figure at the post-delivery check.
rules.source: Feature Scoring Model, 25 Sep 2026 (Ajay Singh)
rules.drives: Signer shown on the entry, Awaiting me, permissions

rules.name: Named owners per layer
rules.value: sales: Chris · operations: Susan, Ilaria · pe-ledger: Ajay · pe-delivery: Bartosz · funding approver: Chris (Sales- or relationship-raised), Chris or Ajay (otherwise)
rules.why: Owners are data, so a change of owner is a Logic save with its own history, not a code change.
rules.source: Feature Scoring Model, 25 Sep 2026 (Ajay Singh)
rules.drives: Permissions for sign, review, estimate, approve, pickup, check

rules.name: Who confirms a funded entry depends on who raised it
rules.value: raisingLayer sales or relationship: Chris only. Any other route (e.g. raised by Ajay, P&E, Operations, or a customer directly): Chris or Ajay. The funding approver confirms the deal and its terms and signs the figure when the lever is revenue, so the entry still carries one figure signature.
rules.why: Funded features also come through Product & Engineering, not only Sales; the relationship owner confirms what Sales or the relationship team sold.
rules.source: Owner instruction, 27 Sep 2026
rules.drives: Sign and confirm buttons, tier 2, permissions, post-delivery check answerer

rules.name: Nobody signs a figure they raised
rules.value: If the signer raised the entry, the other owner of the same layer signs. Where only one person may sign (Chris for Sales; Ajay raising a funded entry, which the owner allows), the entry is signed and flagged self-signed for the weekly review and the pickup meeting.
rules.why: A second pair of eyes on every figure, without blocking a layer that has only one signer.
rules.source: Proposed in exploring/, 27 Sep 2026; not yet agreed

rules.name: A signature is void when what it signed changes
rules.value: Changing lever, figure or assumption voids the figure signature and returns the entry to submitted; changing funded or growth terms voids that confirmation, which the funding approver re-confirms, and re-derives the tier.
rules.why: A signature has to mean the figure on the page, not an earlier one.
rules.source: Proposed in exploring/, 27 Sep 2026; not yet agreed

rules.name: Approval to the ledger is not a commitment to build
rules.value: approved = valid, signed, costed and ranked, with no dates. Only the product-business meeting sets picked-up, and only picked-up carries expected start and due dates.
rules.why: Owner, 27 Sep 2026: approval does not mean it will be picked up; that is the final decision, with a status and dates from the estimate.
rules.source: Owner instruction, 27 Sep 2026

rules.name: Four tiers, first match wins
rules.value: 1 must-have (agreed at the product-business meeting) · 2 increase-revenue + funded (confirmed) + estimated · 3 existing and growing (sized) · 4 everything else.
rules.why: The ledger order the model sets; within a tier, net value decides.
rules.source: Feature Scoring Model, 25 Sep 2026 (Ajay Singh)

rules.name: Net value = figure − build cost
rules.value: buildCostGBP = effortDays × fs-day-rate; netValueGBP = figureGBP − buildCostGBP. Ranked highest first within a tier; ties: funded, earlier neededBy, earlier signed date.
rules.why: A £20k feature that costs £50k shows up as such before it is queued.
rules.source: Feature Scoring Model, 25 Sep 2026 (Ajay Singh)

rules.name: Negative net value needs a reason to pick up
rules.value: Sorted to the bottom of its tier, labelled Costs more than it returns; a pickup needs a meeting reason.
rules.why: Keeps judgement calls visible rather than blocked.
rules.source: Proposed in exploring/, 27 Sep 2026; not yet agreed

rules.name: Picking up out of tier order is recorded
rules.value: A pickup ahead of a higher-ranked unpicked entry records the entries it jumped and the reason.
rules.why: The model leaves competing priorities between tiers to the business; the ledger records the call.
rules.source: Feature Scoring Model, 25 Sep 2026 (Ajay Singh)

rules.name: Every figure is stated over 12 months
rules.why: Revenue and hours must be on one horizon or net values are not comparable. To set.
rules.source: Proposed in exploring/, 27 Sep 2026; not yet agreed

rules.name: Engineering day rate for build cost
rules.why: Turns the estimate into £. To set by Product & Engineering; no figure is invented here.
rules.source: Proposed in exploring/, 27 Sep 2026; not yet agreed

rules.name: Hourly rate for reduce-cost and avoid-cost figures
rules.why: Operations confirms the rate behind every hours figure; one default keeps entries comparable. The model's example (100 hours = £20k) implies £200/h but is an example, not the rate. To set.
rules.source: Feature Scoring Model, 25 Sep 2026 (Ajay Singh)

rules.name: Default people on one entry
rules.why: To set by Bartosz.
rules.source: Proposed in exploring/, 27 Sep 2026; not yet agreed

rules.name: QA allowance added to duration
rules.why: To set from the measured QA cycle median (exploration/flow.md, fl-intervals).
rules.source: Proposed in exploring/, 27 Sep 2026; not yet agreed

rules.name: Release allowance added to duration
rules.why: To set from the measured release hold median (exploration/flow.md).
rules.source: Proposed in exploring/, 27 Sep 2026; not yet agreed

rules.name: Lead time from pickup to earliest start
rules.why: To set.
rules.source: Proposed in exploring/, 27 Sep 2026; not yet agreed

rules.name: Due-date range for a low-confidence estimate
rules.why: To set; share of duration added to the late end of the range.
rules.source: Proposed in exploring/, 27 Sep 2026; not yet agreed

rules.name: Grace before a start counts as late
rules.why: To set.
rules.source: Proposed in exploring/, 27 Sep 2026; not yet agreed

rules.name: How expected start and due are derived
rules.value: duration = ceil(effortDays / allocationFTE) + fs-qa-allowance + fs-release-allowance; start = next business day ≥ max(pickup + fs-pickup-lead, team free from, dependencies' due, earliestStart); due = start + duration − 1 business days. Weekends stripped (fl-business-days), holidays not (fl-holidays). The first schedule is frozen as the baseline.
rules.why: Dates come from the estimate and the team's queue, never typed.
rules.source: Proposed in exploring/, 27 Sep 2026; not yet agreed

rules.name: When the post-delivery check is due
rules.value: increase-revenue: expansion date or 90 days · retain-revenue: next renewal · reduce-cost: 60 days · avoid-cost: 90 days.
rules.why: Revenue and saved hours show up at different speeds.
rules.source: Proposed in exploring/, 27 Sep 2026; not yet agreed

rules.name: Share of the figure that counts as held
rules.why: To set.
rules.source: Proposed in exploring/, 27 Sep 2026; not yet agreed

rules.name: Times a check may be marked too early
rules.why: To set.
rules.source: Proposed in exploring/, 27 Sep 2026; not yet agreed

rules.name: Every action is an append-only event
rules.value: Log, sign, void, review, estimate, approve, pickup, re-plan, deliver, check and every field edit write an event (who, role, when, from, to, reason, meeting) in the same update as the change; events are never edited or deleted, corrections are new events.
rules.why: Extends pp-history: the ledger must show who logged, signed, approved and decided every entry.
rules.source: pp-history; owner instruction, 27 Sep 2026
rules.drives: Entry history, Logged by, Awaiting me, signer track record, meeting record

rules.name: Every entry shows its current stage to everyone
rules.value: Ten steps: Draft · Awaiting signature · Awaiting review · Awaiting estimate · Awaiting approval · On the ledger, not scheduled · Picked up · In delivery · Delivered, check due · Done; plus Needs details (at the step it came from) and Stopped. Each shows who it is waiting on, the next action and days in stage. Derived from status and the latest event, never typed.
rules.why: Everyone should be able to see where a feature is and who has it, without asking.
rules.source: Owner instruction, 27 Sep 2026
rules.drives: Stage column, entry progress bar, Awaiting me, Needs details, filters

rules.name: How long an entry may sit in a stage before it is flagged
rules.why: Proposed: 10 business days in Awaiting review; the others to set. Amber at the limit, red at twice it.
rules.source: Proposed in exploring/, 27 Sep 2026; not yet agreed

rules.name: Ajay can send an entry back to the requester for details at any stage before pickup
rules.value: From submitted, signed, reviewed, estimated, approved or parked. Needs at least one item (field + question), is assigned to the requester with a due date, and shows as Needs details at the step it came from. Once every item is answered and resubmitted it returns to that same step; if a signed value changed it goes back to Awaiting signature.
rules.why: Missing detail is fixed by the person who has it, visibly, without losing the entry's place.
rules.source: Owner instruction, 27 Sep 2026
rules.drives: Return button, infoRequest, Needs details view, resubmit

rules.name: Default time to answer a details request
rules.why: To set; proposed 5 business days. After it, the entry turns red and Ajay is reminded.
rules.source: Proposed in exploring/, 27 Sep 2026; not yet agreed

rules.name: Details score on every entry
rules.value: Share of the detail and value fields filled (02-entry-schema.md sections 2a and 3), with the missing fields named. Shown next to the stage; does not change the rank.
rules.why: The owner wants as much detail as possible; showing the gaps early saves a round trip.
rules.source: Owner instruction, 27 Sep 2026

rules.name: Five fields to log; the rest before signing
rules.value: Needed to log: raised by, title, client (or Platform), product area ("Not sure" allowed), problem statement. Every other field that was required at S (raising layer, source reference, evidence, customers, users affected, user story, workaround, lever, figure, assumption, deal or contract details, funding, existing growth) is required before signing (G): the item logs at step 2 as "Awaiting details" and cannot be signed until they are filled.
rules.why: Requesters often do not know the commercial fields; making them block logging stops people logging at all (owner, 28 Sep 2026).
rules.source: Owner decision, 28 Sep 2026
rules.drives: Entry form (* and "before signing" marks), Log, current stage, signing

rules.name: Hand a before-signing field to a colleague
rules.value: Any before-signing field can be handed to a named colleague (v.handoff[field] = {to, by, at}); the item waits on them until it is filled. Suggested owners: growth, funding, deal and contract details → Chris (Sales); hourly rate and its source → Susan (Operations). The colleague, the logger, the raiser or Ajay fills them in from the item (event k "fill"); each hand-off is an event k "handoff".
rules.why: Puts each missing detail with the person who knows it, instead of blocking the requester (owner, 28 Sep 2026).
rules.source: Owner decision, 28 Sep 2026
rules.drives: Entry form, item pop-up, Waiting on me, history
